name: Mi 6

images.credit: GKyusya, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (front-mounted), proximity sensor, ambient light sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, notification LED, Hall effect sensor, barometer, splash resistant

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 7.1.1 Nougat with MIUI 8, Current: Android 9 Pie with MIUI 11
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm Snapdragon 835 (10 nm), octa-core (4×2.45 GHz Kryo & 4×1.9 GHz Kryo)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12 MP, f/1.8, 27 mm (wide), 1/2.9", 1.25 µm, PDAF, 4-axis OIS + 12 MP, f/2.6, 52 mm (telephoto), 1.0 µm, AF, 2x optical zoom, Dual-LED dual-tone flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps, 720p@120fps

Battery.Battery: Non-removable Li-Po 3350 mAh, 18 W fast charging, Quick Charge 3.0

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, Bluetooth 5.0 (A2DP, LE), NFC, Infrared port, Wi-Fi 802.11ac (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, DLNA, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou
